text: doctor came to you said he couldn't play sports said he wouldn't be able to say I love you to you. Yeah that must have been heartbreaking was terribly heartbreaking and but I was stuck in denial for for a period of time I really was and I talk about that in my book of just being that that father and that man that wanted to fix my son and really didn't him and so for a period of time we didn't connect and she was rolling up her sleeve she was reading every book she was talking to families she was talking to doctors and she was sending me books and I throw them under my bed not read them and it came to a point where I really had to almost get embarrassed by the treatment that was given to him and understand that I needed to really put away all my expectations really come down to his level and understand what autism is. I went on the war path and he you know sort of retreated and so I'm really blessed that we were able to meet in the middle and I think Roddy's book not things that are early on our doctor said he would never ever do and so we're lucky in that respect
